hotels.title: Luxurious English Countryside Manor near Bath with Daily Breakfast & Spa Access
hotels.description: A historic country house with a fresh, Asian approach to hospitality, Montigo Resorts Somerset brings something unexpected to the English countryside. Heritage architecture, landscaped grounds and a strong food-and-wellness offering create a stay that feels both characterful and restorative, all within easy reach of some of Somerset’s best-known sights. The spa remains a highlight, with a hydrotherapy pool, Finnish sauna, crystal steam room and Roman-inspired laconium, alongside treatments that draw on both Asian and European traditions. Outdoors, guests can unwind in the open-air hot tub or make the most of the surrounding gardens and peaceful countryside setting. Dining puts seasonal, locally sourced ingredients at the centre, while Bath is within easy reach for a change of scene. One of England’s best-known heritage cities, it’s celebrated for its remarkably preserved Roman Baths, elegant Georgian architecture and UNESCO-listed cityscape.
